input.summary: Add a Licensor indemnity (IP infringement, breach of law, data breach, gross negligence/wilful misconduct) and narrow the one-way Licensee indemnity in Article XII.
input.comment: [Playbook] Article XII currently runs only against us, and Article XIII expressly excludes Licensor liability for infringement claims, so we have no protection if the Licensed Technology infringes a third party's rights. We have added a reciprocal Licensor indemnity for third-party IP claims, breach of law, Licensor-caused data incidents and wilful misconduct, and narrowed our own indemnity to Licensee-provided content and our breach; if preferred, we can accept the usual IP exclusions (our modifications, combinations, specifications) and remedies plus a 3x annual fees super-cap.

ops.text: ARTICLE XII-A LICENSOR INDEMNITY Licensor shall defend, indemnify and hold harmless Licensee and its Affiliates from and against any third-party claim, and all resulting damages, costs and expenses (including reasonable attorney's fees), to the extent arising out of (a) an allegation that the Licensed Technology, the API's, the Documentation or any deliverable infringes or misappropriates any intellectual property right; (b) Licensor's breach of applicable law; (c) any unauthorized access to or disclosure of Licensee's data or Confidential Information caused by Licensor; or (d) Licensor's gross negligence or wilful misconduct. Licensee shall give Licensor prompt written notice of the claim, Licensor shall have control of the defense and settlement (provided that no settlement imposing any liability or admission on Licensee shall be made without Licensee's prior written consent), and Licensee shall provide reasonable cooperation at Licensor's expense. Licensor's obligations under this Article are not subject to the exclusions or limitations of liability set forth in Article XIII.
